Kotkan Työväen Palloilijat is a Finnish professional football club based in Kotka, currently competing in Finland's second top tier, the Ykkösliiga. The club was founded in 1927 and its colours are green and white. Immediately after its formation, the club joined the Finnish Workers' Sports Federation, to which it still belongs. KTP plays its home matches at the Arto Tolsa Areena.
